title: Sources: an EU investigation is set to find that Azure and AWS meet DMA thresholds, as the EU strengthens its regulatory scrutiny of the cloud sector (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: an EU investigation is set to find that Azure and AWS meet DMA thresholds, as the EU strengthens its regulatory scrutiny of the cloud sector — Microsoft Corp.'s Azure and Amazon Web Services are set to be designated under the European Union's strict rulebook for Big Tech.
